intro: You work in the group finance office. Work out how much the customer {customer} has to pay on invoice {number} from our subsidiary {seller} ({country}), dated {date}.
Group finance needs the outstanding amount on invoice {number}, issued by {seller} in {country} to {customer} on {date}.
A colleague at {seller} ({country}) asks you to check invoice {number} of {date} to {customer}.
head_rate: | Line | Description | Qty | Unit price excl. VAT | VAT{disc} |
head_cat: | Line | Description | Qty | Unit price excl. VAT | VAT category{disc} |
rules: Rules: line amount = quantity × unit price. Discounts are deducted from the line amount before VAT. VAT is calculated per line on the amount after discount. Discount and VAT are rounded per line to whole cents (minor units); exactly half rounds up.
handbook: Excerpt from the group finance handbook, {country}: VAT rates by category — {rates}. Each line is priced at quantity × unit price; a line discount is taken off before VAT is computed on the remainder. Round discounts and VAT on each line to the minor unit, halves upward.
credit: A credit note of {amount} excluding VAT (standard rate) is to be deducted.
paid: The customer has already paid {amount} on this invoice.
round: The amount due is rounded to whole currency units ({unit}); a half rounds up.
rc_rule: Group policy: if the customer is a business in another EU member state and its VAT number is shown on the invoice, no VAT is charged (reverse charge); otherwise the issuing country's rates apply.
buyer_novat: Customer: {customer}, {city}, {buyer_country}; no VAT number on file.
question: How much, including VAT, remains to be paid?
What is the remaining amount due, VAT included?
